Next.|A [[Coastal defender stormtrooper|shoretrooper]] processes Tuck Hybecks|}} '''Belsavis''' was an astronomical object located in the [[Bozhnee sector]]'s [[Belsavis system]] within an intersecting portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories]] and the [[Western Reaches]]. Situated at the coordinates L-18 on the [[Standard Galactic Grid]], it was connected via [[hyperspace route]] to the astronomical object [[Karfeddion]] and was located near the [[Thull's Shroud]], a location where the [[Nihil]] [[Pirate|marauder]] group operated during the [[High Republic Era]].''[[The High Republic: Light of the Jedi]]'' During the [[Imperial Era]], the [[Galactic Empire]] had a [[Prison|penal]] site at Belsavis.{{Andor|Narkina 5 (episode)}} In [[5 BBY]],{{AndorDate|108}} the Empire sent a group of newly convicted [[prisoner]]s on the [[planet]]{{Databank|niamos|Niamos}} [[Niamos]], including the [[human]] [[Tuck Hybecks]], to Belsavis to where they would carry out their sentences. ==Behind the scenes== Belsavis was introduced in the new ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] on a [[Galaxy|galactic]] [[Star map|map]] included in the article "[[Where in the Galaxy Are the Worlds of Star Wars: The Force Awakens?|Where in the Galaxy Are the Worlds of ''Star Wars: The Force Awakens''?]]" by [[Mark Newbold]], published on [[StarWars.com]] on [[January 29]], [[2016]]. It's name was obscured in that article,{{SW|url=news/where-in-the-galaxy-are-the-worlds-of-star-wars-the-force-awakens|text=Where in the Galaxy Are the Worlds of ''Star Wars: The Force Awakens''?|int=Where in the Galaxy Are the Worlds of Star Wars: The Force Awakens?}} but Belsavis's complete name was introduced in a map included in [[Star Wars: The Force Awakens Beginner Game|''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'' Beginner Game]],[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens Beginner Game|''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'' Beginner Game]] an [[August]] 2016{{FantasyFlightGames|url=en/news/2016/7/26/what-will-you-do|text=What Will You Do?}} [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' boxed set. Originating in [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] was introduced in the [[1995]] novel [[Children of the Jedi (novel)|''Children of the Jedi'']], written by [[Barbara Hambly]].[[Children of the Jedi (novel)|''Children of the Jedi'']] ==Appearances== {{Indexpage}} *''[[The High Republic: Light of the Jedi]]'' {{Ab|The High Republic: Light of the Jedi (audiobook)}} {{Mo}} *{{Andor|Narkina 5 (episode)}} {{Mo}} ==Sources== *{{SW|url=news/where-in-the-galaxy-are-the-worlds-of-star-wars-the-force-awakens|text=Where in the Galaxy Are the Worlds of ''Star Wars: The Force Awakens''?|int=Where in the Galaxy Are the Worlds of Star Wars: The Force Awakens?}} {{1stm}} {{MapPoint}} *[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens Beginner Game|''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'' Beginner Game]] {{1stID|Belsavis}} {{MapPoint}} *''[[Star Wars: Complete Locations, New Edition]]'' {{MapPoint}} *''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]'' {{MapPoint}} *{{StarWarsGalaxyMap}} {{MapPoint}} ==Notes and references== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Belsavis}} {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Belsavis |fi=Belsavis |fr=Belsavis |ka=ბელსავისი |pl=Belsavis }} [[Category:Astronomical objects in the Outer Rim Territories]] [[Category:Astronomical objects in the Western Reaches]] [[Category:Belsavis system locations]]
